story: In 494 BCE Wu crushed Yue, and King Goujian of Yue had to surrender. He went to Wu and served King Fuchai almost as a servant. After he was allowed home, he worked for years with his ministers Fan Li and Wen Zhong to rebuild Yue. They encouraged farming and a growing population. Later stories say Goujian slept on brushwood and tasted bitter gall so he would never forget his shame.

Fuchai, meanwhile, spent his strength on wars in the north and on rivalry with Jin. He also forced his best adviser, Wu Zixu, to kill himself. In 482 BCE Yue attacked Wu while Fuchai was away at a meeting of lords. Years of fighting followed. At last Yue besieged the Wu capital at Gusu, and in 473 BCE Fuchai killed himself. Goujian then marched north and was recognized as a hegemon.
story_zh: 前494年，吴国大败越国，越王勾践被迫投降，到吴国给吴王夫差做近乎奴仆的差事。获释回国后，他与大夫范蠡、文种一起苦心经营多年，鼓励耕种，增加人口。后世传说他睡在柴草上、时常尝一尝苦胆，提醒自己不忘耻辱，这就是“卧薪尝胆”。
夫差却把力气花在北上争霸、与晋国较劲上，还逼死了最得力的谋臣伍子胥。前482年，越国趁夫差北上会盟，偷袭吴国。此后两国又打了多年。最终越军围困吴都姑苏，前473年夫差自杀。勾践随即挥师北上，成为一方霸主。
yue-wu.why: The fall of Wu made Yue the leading power of the southeast. Goujian's patience became one of China's best-known stories of revenge.
yue-wu.why_zh: 吴国灭亡后，越国成为东南霸主；勾践忍辱复仇的故事也成了家喻户晓的典故。

people.name: Wu Zixu
people.role: Adviser to the King of Wu

story: By the 450s BCE the dukes of Jin had lost real power to a few great ministerial families. The strongest was the Zhi family, led by Zhi Yao. He demanded land from the Han, Wei and Zhao families. Han and Wei gave in, but Zhao Xiangzi refused and retreated to his walled city of Jinyang.

Zhi Yao, with Han and Wei at his side, besieged Jinyang from 455 BCE. He diverted a river to flood the city, and the defenders were close to giving up. Then Zhao's adviser Zhang Mengtan slipped out and secretly persuaded Han and Wei that they would be next. In 453 BCE the three families broke the dikes so that the water flooded Zhi's own camp. They destroyed his army, killed Zhi Yao and divided his lands.
story_zh: 到公元前五世纪中叶，晋国国君早已大权旁落，实权掌握在几大卿族手中，其中最强的是智瑶为首的智氏。智瑶向韩、魏、赵三家索要土地，韩、魏只得割让，赵襄子却断然拒绝，退守自家的坚城晋阳。
从前455年起，智瑶带着韩、魏两家围攻晋阳，又引河水灌城，城中几乎支撑不住。赵氏谋臣张孟谈暗中出城，劝说韩、魏：智氏灭赵之后，下一个就轮到你们。前453年，三家掘开堤坝，让洪水反灌智氏军营，一举歼灭智军，杀死智瑶，瓜分了智氏的土地。
jinyang.why: The battle removed the last family that could hold Jin together. Many historians date the start of the Warring States to this moment.
jinyang.why_zh: 这一战除掉了唯一还能维系晋国统一的势力。许多史家把它视为战国时代的开端。

story: After the Battle of Jinyang, the Han, Zhao and Wei families ruled most of Jin's territory as if it were their own. The dukes of Jin kept only a small area around their capital and had to pay court to their former ministers.

In 403 BCE King Weilie of Zhou formally named the three family heads, Wei Si, Zhao Ji and Han Qian, as marquises. Their seizure of power was now legal in the eyes of the old ritual order. The last remnants of the Jin ruling house were wiped out a few decades later.

Fourteen centuries later the historian Sima Guang began his great chronicle, the Comprehensive Mirror, with this year. For him, the king's approval of usurpers showed how the Zhou order of ranks and rituals had collapsed.
story_zh: 晋阳之战后，韩、赵、魏三家把晋国的大部分土地当作自家领地来治理。晋国国君只剩都城附近一小块地方，反倒要向昔日的臣下朝拜。
前403年，周威烈王正式册封魏斯、赵籍、韩虔为诸侯。三家篡夺晋国，从此在礼法上也名正言顺。几十年后，晋国公室最后的残余也被消灭。
一千四百多年后，北宋史学家司马光编写《资治通鉴》，就从这一年开篇。在他看来，周天子承认篡位者，标志着周朝的礼制秩序已经彻底崩坏。
three-jin.why: It marked the official birth of three of the seven Warring States and the end of the old idea that rank was fixed by birth.
three-jin.why_zh: 这标志着战国七雄中的三国正式诞生，也意味着名分由出身决定的旧观念走到了尽头。

quote.zh: 初命晋大夫魏斯、赵籍、韩虔为诸侯。
quote.en: For the first time, the Jin grandees Wei Si, Zhao Ji and Han Qian were named feudal lords.

story: Zheng was an old state founded in the late Western Zhou. It sat in the middle of the Central Plain, at the crossroads of trade routes, but it was squeezed between larger neighbours. In the Spring and Autumn period it had survived by switching sides between Jin and Chu.

After Jin broke up, the new state of Han, which held the hilly land to the west, kept pressing on Zheng. In 375 BCE Marquis Ai of Han conquered it. Han then moved its capital to the old Zheng city, which became known as Xinzheng, 'New Zheng'.

The move put Han in a rich farming area, but also left it surrounded by Wei, Chu, Qin and the Zhou royal lands. Han stayed the smallest of the seven powers and was the first to fall to Qin, in 230 BCE.
story_zh: 郑国是西周末年分封的老国家，地处中原腹地、商路交汇之处，却夹在几个大国之间。春秋时期，它靠在晋、楚两强之间来回摇摆才得以保全。
晋国解体后，占据西边山地的新兴韩国不断进逼郑国。前375年，韩哀侯灭掉郑国，把都城迁到原郑国都城，这座城从此被称为“新郑”。
迁都让韩国得到了富庶的农耕区，却也被魏、楚、秦和周王畿团团围住。韩国始终是七雄中最弱小的一个，前230年第一个被秦国灭掉。
han-zheng.why: It ended one of the oldest Zhou states and fixed Han's capital in the place it would keep until Qin's conquest.
han-zheng.why_zh: 郑国这个周朝老牌诸侯就此消失，新郑也成了韩国此后直到亡国的都城。

story: Wei was the strongest state of the early Warring States, but its heartland around Anyi in southern Shanxi lay close to Qin. Its lands west of the Yellow River were a constant battleground. Wei also held rich territory far to the east on the North China Plain.

Around 361 BCE Marquis Hui of Wei, later known as King Hui, moved his capital east to Daliang, near modern Kaifeng. The new capital sat at the centre of the plain, close to trade routes and other states. Wei began digging the Honggou canal to link Daliang with the rivers of the region.

After the move Wei was often called Liang, and its ruler is the 'King Hui of Liang' who talks with Mencius in the Mencius. More than a century later, in 225 BCE, Qin flooded Daliang and ended the state.
story_zh: 魏国是战国初期最强的国家，但它的根基安邑一带（今山西南部）紧邻秦国，黄河以西的领土更是战事不断。与此同时，魏国在东边的华北平原上也拥有大片富饶土地。
约前361年，魏惠侯（后来称王，即魏惠王）把都城东迁到大梁（今开封附近）。新都位于平原中央，靠近商路和各国，交通便利。魏国随后开挖鸿沟，把大梁与周边水系连接起来。
迁都后，魏国常被称作“梁”，《孟子》中与孟子对话的“梁惠王”就是他。一百多年后的前225年，秦军引水灌入大梁，魏国就此灭亡。
daliang.why: The move showed how Qin's pressure was pushing the other states east, and it made Daliang a key city of the plain.
daliang.why_zh: 迁都说明秦国的压力正迫使各国向东退缩，大梁也由此成为中原的重要城市。

story: Duke Xiao of Qin came to power in 361 BCE and invited talented men to make his backward state strong. Wei Yang, later called Lord Shang or Shang Yang, came from the small state of Wey. In 356 BCE the duke put him in charge of sweeping reforms.

To show that the state kept its word, Shang Yang set up a pole at the city gate and promised gold to anyone who moved it. When a man did, he was paid at once. The new laws grouped households in fives and tens that were punished together for crimes. Families were rewarded for farming and weaving, and soldiers earned ranks by cutting off enemy heads. Old nobles lost privileges unless they won merit in war.
A second round of reforms in 350 BCE set up counties ruled by appointed officials, allowed land to be bought and sold, and standardized weights and measures.
story_zh: 秦孝公于前361年即位，广招人才，想让落后的秦国强大起来。来自卫国的卫鞅（后封商君，世称商鞅）投奔秦国，前356年受命主持变法。
为了让百姓相信官府言出必行，商鞅在城门立了一根木杆，宣布谁能把它搬走就赏金，有人搬了，当场兑现，这就是“徙木立信”。新法把百姓按五家、十家编组，一家犯法，邻里连坐；努力耕织的人家受奖，士兵凭斩获敌人首级获得爵位；旧贵族没有军功便失去特权。
前350年的第二轮变法又设立由国君任命官吏的县，允许土地买卖，并统一了度量衡。
shang-yang.why: The reforms made Qin the most efficient military state of the age and laid the foundation for its unification of China.
shang-yang.why_zh: 变法使秦国成为当时组织最严密的军事强国，为日后统一中国打下了基础。

people.name: Shang Yang
people.role: Reformer and chief minister of Qin

story: In 354 BCE the powerful state of Wei sent its army, led by Pang Juan, to besiege Handan, the capital of Zhao. Zhao asked Qi for help. King Wei of Qi gave command to Tian Ji, with the strategist Sun Bin as his adviser. Sun Bin had once studied with Pang Juan, who out of jealousy had him mutilated.

Instead of marching straight to Handan, Sun Bin advised striking at Wei's own capital, which had been left lightly defended. The Wei army had to rush home. As it hurried back, tired and strung out, the Qi army ambushed it at Guiling and won a clear victory.
The tactic became a proverb: 'besiege Wei to save Zhao' (围魏救赵), meaning to relieve an ally by threatening the enemy's weak point.
story_zh: 前354年，强大的魏国派庞涓率军围攻赵国都城邯郸。赵国向齐国求救，齐威王命田忌为将、孙膑为军师。孙膑曾与庞涓同窗，后遭庞涓嫉妒陷害，受了膑刑。
孙膑没有直奔邯郸，而是建议进攻防守空虚的魏国都城。魏军只得回师救援，一路急行，疲惫不堪，队伍拉得很长。齐军在桂陵设下埋伏，大败魏军。
这一战法后来成了成语“围魏救赵”，意思是攻击敌人的要害，迫使其撤兵，以解救被围的一方。
guiling.why: It was the first great clash between Qi and Wei and showed that cunning could beat the strongest army of the day.
guiling.why_zh: 这是齐、魏之间的第一场大战，证明了谋略可以战胜当时最强的军队。

story: In 316 BCE the two kingdoms of the Sichuan basin, Ba and Shu, were at war with each other, and both asked Qin for help. At the Qin court the minister Zhang Yi argued for attacking Han and the Zhou royal lands instead. The general Sima Cuo disagreed. Shu, he said, was rich, far away and easy to take, and no other state would complain.

King Huiwen of Qin chose Sima Cuo's plan. The Qin army crossed the Qinling mountains on narrow mountain roads, defeated Shu within months and then took Ba as well. Qin later settled thousands of families in the region and built a new walled city at Chengdu.
Decades later the governor Li Bing built the Dujiangyan irrigation works, which made the Chengdu plain one of the most fertile places in China.
story_zh: 前316年，四川盆地的巴、蜀两国交战，双方都向秦国求援。秦国朝堂上，张仪主张转而攻打韩国和周王畿；将军司马错则认为，蜀地富饶偏远、容易攻取，而且打下来也不会招致其他诸侯非议。
秦惠文王采纳了司马错的意见。秦军沿崎岖的山道翻越秦岭，几个月内灭掉蜀国，随后又吞并巴国。此后秦国向这里迁入数以万计的人口，并在成都修筑了新城。
几十年后，蜀郡守李冰修建都江堰，使成都平原成为全国最富饶的地区之一。
qin-bashu.why: Ba and Shu gave Qin a huge granary and a route down the Yangtze to attack Chu, a key step toward unification.
qin-bashu.why_zh: 巴蜀为秦国提供了巨大的粮仓，又打开了顺长江而下进攻楚国的通道，是秦国走向统一的关键一步。

story: Zhao bordered the steppe in the north, where nomad peoples such as the Linhu and Loufan fought on horseback. Chinese armies still relied on chariots and foot soldiers in long robes. In 307 BCE King Wuling of Zhao decided to copy the nomads.

He ordered his soldiers to wear the short jacket and trousers of the steppe and to train as mounted archers. Many nobles, including his own uncle, protested that abandoning Chinese dress was shameful. The king argued that customs should serve the state, and he won them over.

The new cavalry let Zhao defeat the nomads, set up new frontier commanderies and conquer Zhongshan. In 299 BCE Wuling handed the throne to his son. A few years later he was trapped during a struggle among his sons and starved to death in the Shaqiu palace.
story_zh: 赵国北面与草原接壤，林胡、楼烦等游牧部族骑马作战，而中原军队仍以战车和身穿长袍的步兵为主。前307年，赵武灵王决定向游牧民族学习。
他下令士兵改穿草原民族的短衣长裤，练习骑马射箭。包括他叔父在内的许多贵族反对，认为抛弃华夏衣冠是耻辱。武灵王则主张，习俗应当为国家服务，最终说服了众人。
新组建的骑兵帮助赵国打败游牧部族，设立新的边郡，并攻灭中山国。前299年，武灵王传位给儿子。几年后，他在儿子们争位的变乱中被困沙丘宫，活活饿死。
hu-fu.why: It was the first large-scale use of cavalry by a Chinese state and changed how wars were fought in the north.
hu-fu.why_zh: 这是中原国家第一次大规模建立骑兵，改变了北方的作战方式。

story: Zhongshan was a state founded by the Xianyu, a branch of the Di people, in what is now central Hebei. Its capital was at Lingshou. It adopted much of Chinese culture and in 323 BCE its ruler even took the title of king, along with several larger states.

Zhongshan lay right between Zhao's northern and southern lands, which made it a constant problem for Zhao. After King Wuling built his new cavalry, Zhao attacked Zhongshan again and again from 305 BCE. In 296 BCE it finally destroyed the state and sent its last king into exile.
In the 1970s archaeologists excavated royal tombs of Zhongshan near Pingshan. They found splendid bronzes, including inscribed vessels and a bronze map of a tomb complex.
story_zh: 中山国是狄人的一支鲜虞所建，位于今河北中部，都城在灵寿。它大量吸收了华夏文化，前323年还与几个大国一起称王。
中山正好夹在赵国南北两块领土之间，一直是赵国的心腹之患。赵武灵王组建骑兵后，从前305年起多次进攻中山，前296年终于将其灭亡，中山末代国君被流放。
上世纪七十年代，考古学家在河北平山发掘了中山国王墓，出土了大批精美铜器，其中有带长篇铭文的礼器，还有一块刻着陵园平面图的铜版。
zhao-zhongshan.why: Taking Zhongshan joined Zhao's territory into one block and made Zhao the strongest rival to Qin for a time.
zhao-zhongshan.why_zh: 吞并中山使赵国的领土连成一片，一度成为秦国最强劲的对手。

story: Song, with its capital at Shangqiu, was a mid-sized state whose rulers claimed descent from the Shang kings. It lay on rich land and controlled important trade routes. Its last ruler, King Kang, attacked his neighbours and was later called a tyrant by his enemies.

King Min of Qi, the most ambitious ruler of his day, saw his chance. In 286 BCE Qi invaded and conquered Song, and King Kang died soon after. Qi now controlled much of the eastern plain, and its new borders pressed against Wei, Chu and Lu.
The conquest frightened every other state. Qin, Yan, Zhao, Wei and Han soon formed an alliance against Qi, which led to Yue Yi's invasion two years later.
story_zh: 宋国定都商丘，国君自称商王后裔，是个中等国家。它土地肥沃，扼守重要商路。末代国君宋康王四处攻伐邻国，后来被敌国称为暴君。
当时最有野心的君主齐湣王看准时机，于前286年出兵灭宋，宋康王不久身亡。齐国由此控制了东部平原的大片土地，新的边界直逼魏、楚、鲁诸国。
齐国吞宋令各国震恐。秦、燕、赵、魏、韩很快结成联盟对付齐国，两年后便有了乐毅伐齐。
qi-song.why: Qi's greed for Song turned all its neighbours against it and led directly to its near destruction.
qi-song.why_zh: 齐国贪图宋地，使周边各国一致与它为敌，直接导致了自身几乎覆灭。

story: In 314 BCE Qi had invaded Yan during a civil war. Yan's new ruler, King Zhao, spent decades preparing revenge and invited able men to his court. One of them was Yue Yi. In 284 BCE, with Qi isolated after it annexed Song, Yue Yi led the armies of Yan, Qin, Zhao, Wei and Han against it.

The allies routed Qi west of the Ji River. Yue Yi then marched on alone with the Yan army and took the capital Linzi. Within a few years he held over seventy cities. Only Ju and Jimo held out. King Min fled and was killed at Ju.

In 279 BCE King Zhao died. His son distrusted Yue Yi and replaced him, and Yue Yi fled to Zhao. At Jimo the Qi commander Tian Dan sent oxen with burning tails charging into the Yan camp at night, then won back all of Qi.
story_zh: 前314年，齐国趁燕国内乱出兵入侵。燕昭王即位后，用几十年时间筹划复仇，广招天下贤士，乐毅便是其中之一。前284年，齐国因吞宋而陷入孤立，乐毅率燕、秦、赵、魏、韩五国联军伐齐。
联军在济水以西大破齐军。乐毅随后独率燕军长驱直入，攻下齐都临淄，几年间连下七十余城，只剩莒和即墨两城未被攻破。齐湣王出逃，在莒被杀。
前279年燕昭王去世，继位的燕惠王猜忌乐毅，派人取代了他，乐毅只得逃往赵国。即墨守将田单在夜里把尾巴绑上火把的牛群赶进燕军营地，大破燕军，随后收复了齐国全部失地。
yue-yi.why: Qi never recovered its strength, which removed the one eastern power that might have stopped Qin.
yue-yi.why_zh: 齐国从此元气大伤，东方唯一可能阻挡秦国的大国就此衰落。

story: Qu Yuan was a noble and minister of Chu. He urged King Huai to ally with Qi against Qin, but rivals slandered him and he was sent away from court. King Huai was later tricked into visiting Qin, held there and died in captivity in 296 BCE. Under the next king, Qu Yuan was exiled to the south.
In 278 BCE the Qin general Bai Qi captured Ying, the Chu capital. According to tradition, Qu Yuan, in despair, drowned himself in the Miluo River on the fifth day of the fifth month.

His poems, such as the Li Sao (Encountering Sorrow) and the Nine Songs, are the core of the Chu Ci, the second great collection of early Chinese poetry. The Dragon Boat Festival, with its boat races and zongzi, is said to remember him.
story_zh: 屈原是楚国贵族，曾任要职。他主张联齐抗秦，却遭人谗害，被疏远出朝廷。楚怀王后来受骗入秦，被扣留，前296年客死秦国。到了下一位楚王时，屈原又被流放到南方。
前278年，秦将白起攻破楚都郢。相传屈原悲愤绝望，在五月初五这天投汨罗江而死。
他的《离骚》《九歌》等作品是《楚辞》的核心，《楚辞》也是继《诗经》之后中国早期诗歌的又一座高峰。据说端午节赛龙舟、吃粽子的习俗就是为了纪念他。
qu-yuan.why: Qu Yuan became China's model of the loyal official who is wronged, and the first great poet known by name.
qu-yuan.why_zh: 屈原成了忠而被谤的典范，也是中国第一位留下姓名的伟大诗人。

quote.zh: 举世皆浊我独清，众人皆醉我独醒，是以见放。
quote.en: The whole world is muddy and I alone am clear; everyone is drunk and I alone am sober. That is why I was banished.
quote.from: Chu Ci, 'The Fisherman' 楚辞·渔父

story: In 262 BCE Qin cut off Han's Shangdang commandery, and its governor handed it to Zhao instead of Qin. Qin attacked, and the two strongest armies of the age faced each other at Changping. Zhao's veteran general Lian Po built strong defences and refused to fight, and the standoff lasted for many months.

Qin spread rumours that it feared only Zhao Kuo, a young officer who knew the military books by heart. The King of Zhao replaced Lian Po with him. Qin secretly sent its best general, Bai Qi. When Zhao Kuo attacked, Bai Qi let him advance, cut his supply lines and surrounded his army.

After 46 days without food, Zhao Kuo was killed trying to break out and the army surrendered. The Records of the Grand Historian says Bai Qi had about 400,000 prisoners buried alive. Mass graves have been found near Gaoping.
story_zh: 前262年，秦国切断了韩国的上党郡，上党郡守没有降秦，反而把上党献给赵国。秦国随即出兵，当时最强的两支大军在长平对峙。赵国老将廉颇筑垒坚守，拒不出战，双方相持了很久。
秦国散布流言，说秦国只怕赵括。赵括是个熟读兵书的年轻将领，赵王于是用他换下廉颇。秦国则秘密派出名将白起。赵括出击时，白起佯装退让，切断赵军粮道，把赵军团团围住。
赵军断粮四十六天，赵括突围时战死，全军投降。《史记》记载白起把约四十万降卒全部坑杀。今天在山西高平一带已发现多处尸骨坑。
changping.why: Changping broke Zhao, the last state able to match Qin in the field, and made Qin's unification only a matter of time.
changping.why_zh: 长平之战摧毁了唯一能与秦国正面抗衡的赵国，秦国统一天下已成定局。

story: Han was the smallest and weakest of the seven states, wedged between Qin and the eastern plain. It had tried every trick to survive, including sending its water engineer Zheng Guo to tie Qin down with canal building and sending the thinker Han Fei as an envoy in 233 BCE.

In 231 BCE Han gave up part of its land to Qin. The next year, 230 BCE, King Zheng of Qin sent the official Neishi Teng to attack. He captured King An of Han, and Han's land became Qin's Yingchuan commandery.
With Han gone, Qin controlled the routes into the heart of the plain. Within nine years it would conquer the other five states.
story_zh: 韩国是七国中最小最弱的一个，夹在秦国和东方平原之间。为了自保，它想尽了办法：曾派水工郑国到秦国修渠以消耗秦国国力，前233年又派韩非出使秦国。
前231年，韩国被迫向秦国割地。次年即前230年，秦王嬴政派内史腾进攻，俘虏韩王安，把韩国故地设为秦国的颍川郡。
韩国灭亡后，秦国控制了进入中原腹地的通道。此后九年间，其余五国相继被秦所灭。
qin-han.why: Han was the first of the six states to fall, opening Qin's final decade of conquest.
qin-han.why_zh: 韩国是六国中第一个灭亡的，秦国统一的最后十年由此开始。

story: In 229 BCE Qin sent Wang Jian against Zhao. Zhao's general Li Mu, famous for his victories over the Xiongnu, held him off. Qin then bribed Guo Kai, a favourite at the Zhao court, to spread rumours that Li Mu planned to rebel. King Qian of Zhao believed them and had Li Mu killed.

Without him, Zhao's defence collapsed. In 228 BCE Wang Jian took the capital Handan and captured King Qian. King Zheng of Qin, who had been born in Handan as the son of a hostage, came to the city in person and had his family's old enemies killed.
A Zhao prince, Jia, fled north to Dai and declared himself king there. He held out until 222 BCE.
story_zh: 前229年，秦国派王翦攻赵。曾大败匈奴的赵国名将李牧挡住了秦军。秦国便收买赵王宠臣郭开，散布李牧谋反的谣言。赵王迁信以为真，杀了李牧。
李牧一死，赵国防线迅速瓦解。前228年，王翦攻下邯郸，俘虏赵王迁。秦王嬴政当年作为人质之子生在邯郸，这次亲自来到邯郸，把与他母家有仇的人全部杀掉。
赵国公子嘉逃到北方的代地，自立为王，一直坚持到前222年。
qin-zhao.why: The fall of Handan ended the one state that had fought Qin longest and hardest.
qin-zhao.why_zh: 邯郸陷落，与秦国抗衡最久、最顽强的赵国就此覆灭。

story: Crown Prince Dan of Yan had once been a hostage in Qin and hated King Zheng. As Qin armies closed in, he hired the swordsman Jing Ke to kill the king. To get close, Jing Ke took two gifts: the head of Fan Wuji, a Qin general who had fled to Yan, and a map of Yan's best farmland, Dukang, with a poisoned dagger rolled inside.

At the Yi River, his friend Gao Jianli played the zhu while Jing Ke sang a farewell song. In the Qin palace at Xianyang, he unrolled the map, seized the dagger and grabbed the king's sleeve. The sleeve tore, and the king ran around a pillar. Guards were not allowed to carry weapons in the hall, but at last the king drew his long sword and wounded Jing Ke, who was then killed.
Qin attacked Yan and took its capital the next year.
story_zh: 燕太子丹曾在秦国做人质，对秦王恨之入骨。眼看秦军步步逼近，他请来剑客荆轲刺杀秦王。为了接近秦王，荆轲带上两份礼物：逃到燕国的秦将樊於期的首级，以及燕国最肥沃的督亢地区的地图，地图里卷着一把淬了毒的匕首。
在易水边，好友高渐离击筑，荆轲高歌诀别。到了咸阳宫中，他展开地图，图穷匕见，抓起匕首揪住秦王的衣袖。衣袖扯断，秦王绕着柱子奔逃。殿上侍卫按规定不能携带兵器，最后秦王拔出长剑砍伤荆轲，荆轲随即被杀。
第二年，秦军攻下燕国都城。
jing-ke.why: The failed attempt hastened Qin's attack on Yan and became one of China's most famous stories of courage.
jing-ke.why_zh: 刺杀失败加速了秦国灭燕，这个故事也成为中国最著名的壮士传奇之一。

quote.zh: 风萧萧兮易水寒，壮士一去兮不复还。
quote.en: The wind is sighing, the Yi River is cold; the brave man leaves and will not return.
quote.from: Records of the Grand Historian 史记

story: By 225 BCE Wei had shrunk to the area around its capital, Daliang. Qin sent Wang Ben, the son of Wang Jian, to finish it off. Daliang had strong walls, and a direct assault would have been costly.

Instead, Wang Ben used the land and water around the city. He had his troops cut channels from the Yellow River and the Honggou canal and turned the water against Daliang. After about three months the soaked walls collapsed. King Jia of Wei surrendered, and Wei was absorbed into Qin.
The flood left Daliang badly damaged. The city, later called Bianliang and Kaifeng, would only become a great capital again more than a thousand years later.
story_zh: 到前225年，魏国只剩都城大梁周边一小块地方。秦国派王翦之子王贲前去收尾。大梁城墙坚固，强攻代价太大。
王贲于是借助城外的地形和水道，命士兵开渠引黄河和鸿沟之水灌城。大约三个月后，被水浸泡的城墙倒塌，魏王假投降，魏国并入秦国。
这场水攻使大梁遭到重创。这座城后来称汴梁、开封，要到一千多年后才重新成为大都城。
qin-wei.why: Wei's fall left only Chu, Yan, Qi and the remnant of Zhao standing against Qin.
qin-wei.why_zh: 魏国灭亡后，能与秦国对抗的只剩楚、燕、齐和残存的赵国。

story: Chu was the largest of the six states. In 225 BCE King Zheng asked his generals how many men were needed. The young general Li Xin said 200,000; the veteran Wang Jian said 600,000. The king called Wang Jian timid and sent Li Xin and Meng Tian. The Chu general Xiang Yan routed them.

King Zheng went in person to apologize to the retired Wang Jian and gave him the 600,000 men. Wang Jian built strong camps and refused battle for a long time while his soldiers rested and trained. When the Chu army finally moved off, he attacked and destroyed it.
In 223 BCE Qin captured the Chu king Fuchu at the capital Shouchun, and Xiang Yan died. Chu was finished, but its people did not forget. Xiang Yan's grandson Xiang Yu would help destroy Qin.
story_zh: 楚国是六国中面积最大的。前225年，秦王问将领们需要多少兵力。年轻的李信说二十万，老将王翦说非六十万不可。秦王嫌王翦胆怯，派李信和蒙恬出征，结果被楚将项燕打得大败。
秦王亲自登门向告老还乡的王翦道歉，交给他六十万大军。王翦修筑坚固营垒，长期坚守不战，让士兵休整操练。等楚军撤离时，他乘势出击，一举击溃楚军。
前223年，秦军在楚都寿春俘虏楚王负刍，项燕也兵败身死，楚国灭亡。但楚人并未忘记亡国之恨，项燕的孙子项羽日后成了推翻秦朝的主力。
qin-chu.why: The conquest of the vast south removed Qin's last great rival and left only Yan, Dai and Qi.
qin-chu.why_zh: 征服广大的南方后，秦国最后一个强敌被消灭，只剩燕、代和齐国。

story: After Jing Ke's attempt on his life in 227 BCE, King Zheng sent armies against Yan. In 226 BCE they took the Yan capital, Ji, near modern Beijing. King Xi of Yan fled east to Liaodong. Hoping to calm Qin, he had his own son, Crown Prince Dan, killed and sent his head to Qin. It did not save him.

In 222 BCE, with Chu and Wei gone, Qin sent Wang Ben to Liaodong. He captured King Xi and ended Yan. On his way back he also attacked Dai, where the Zhao prince Jia had ruled as king since 228 BCE, and captured him.
Only Qi was now left. It surrendered without a fight the following year.
story_zh: 前227年荆轲行刺之后，秦王派兵攻燕。前226年秦军攻下燕都蓟城（今北京附近），燕王喜东逃辽东。为了平息秦王的怒气，他杀了亲生儿子太子丹，把首级献给秦国，却仍然没能保全自己。
前222年，楚、魏已亡，秦国派王贲进军辽东，俘虏燕王喜，燕国灭亡。回师途中，王贲又攻打自前228年起在代地称王的赵公子嘉，将其俘获。
此时只剩齐国，第二年它不战而降。
qin-yan.why: The fall of Yan and Dai ended resistance in the north and left Qi alone and helpless.
qin-yan.why_zh: 燕、代灭亡后，北方的抵抗全部结束，齐国彻底孤立无援。

story: Zeng was a small state in what is now Hubei, closely tied to its powerful neighbour Chu. Its ruler, known as Marquis Yi, died around 433 BCE. A bronze bell given by the King of Chu and dated to that year was placed in his tomb.

The tomb was discovered in 1977 at Leigudun near Suizhou and excavated in 1978. It held more than 15,000 objects: weapons, lacquered coffins, ritual bronzes and a chest painted with the names of the 28 lunar mansions, the oldest known full list. About twenty young women were buried with him.

The most famous find is a set of 65 bronze bells hung on a wooden frame. Each bell sounds two different notes depending on where it is struck. Inscriptions on the bells explain the music theory of the time.
story_zh: 曾国是位于今湖北的一个小国，与强大的楚国关系密切。它的国君曾侯乙大约死于前433年，墓中有一件楚王赠送的铜钟，铭文正记着这一年。
这座墓于1977年在随州擂鼓墩被发现，1978年发掘，出土文物超过一万五千件，有兵器、漆棺、青铜礼器，还有一只漆箱，上面写着二十八宿的名称，是目前已知最早的完整二十八宿名录。墓中还有约二十名年轻女子殉葬。
最著名的是一套挂在木架上的65件青铜编钟。每件钟敲击不同部位，可以发出两个不同的音。钟上的铭文记载了当时的乐律理论。
marquis-yi-zeng.why: The bells show that Chinese musicians of the 5th century BCE already used a full twelve-tone system with precise tuning.
marquis-yi-zeng.why_zh: 这套编钟证明，公元前五世纪的中国乐师已经掌握了音高精确的十二律体系。

story: Marquis Wen of Wei, who ruled from 445 to 396 BCE, gathered able advisers to make his new state strong. The most important was Li Kui, who served as his chief minister around 400 BCE.

Li Kui told farmers to make full use of the land, growing several crops and working the fields harder. He also set up a grain policy: the state bought grain when harvests were good and prices low, and sold it in bad years to keep prices steady. He took away the hereditary income of nobles who did nothing and gave it to men who served the state.
Li Kui is also credited with the Canon of Laws (Fajing), a code of criminal law collected from different states. Later tradition says Shang Yang took it with him to Qin.
story_zh: 魏文侯（前445年至前396年在位）广招贤才，想让新建立的魏国强大起来。其中最重要的一位是李悝，大约在公元前400年前后担任魏国的相。
李悝提出“尽地力之教”，鼓励农民多种作物、精耕细作；又推行“平籴法”：丰年粮价低时由官府收购，荒年再平价卖出，以稳定粮价。他还取消了无功贵族世袭的俸禄，转给为国家效力的人。
相传李悝还汇集各国刑律，编成《法经》。后世说商鞅入秦时就带着这部法典。
li-kui-reforms.why: Li Kui's reforms made Wei the leading power of the early Warring States and became a model for later Legalist reformers.
li-kui-reforms.why_zh: 李悝变法使魏国成为战国初期最强的国家，也成为后来法家变法的榜样。

story: The Tian family descended from a prince of Chen who fled to Qi in the 7th century BCE. Over generations they won support by lending grain with a large measure and taking repayment with a small one. In 481 BCE Tian Chang killed the ruling duke and took control of the government.

For the next century the Jiang dukes, descendants of the founder Jiang Taigong, ruled in name only. Tian He sent the last of them, Duke Kang, to live by the sea. In 386 BCE the Zhou king recognized Tian He himself as ruler of Qi.
The state kept the name Qi, but historians call it Tian Qi to set it apart from the older Jiang Qi. Its rulers later took the title of king and turned Linzi into a centre of learning.
story_zh: 田氏是陈国一位公子的后裔，公元前七世纪逃到齐国。几代人下来，田氏用大斗借出粮食、小斗收回，赢得了百姓的拥护。前481年，田常杀死齐简公，掌握了齐国大权。
此后一百年间，姜太公后裔的姜姓国君只是名义上的君主。田和把最后一位姜姓国君齐康公迁到海边居住。前386年，周天子正式承认田和为齐国国君。
国号仍然叫齐，但史家称之为“田齐”，以区别于此前的“姜齐”。田齐国君后来称王，还把临淄建成了学术中心。
tian-qi.why: Like the partition of Jin, it showed that in this age power, not birth, decided who ruled.
tian-qi.why_zh: 与三家分晋一样，田氏代齐表明，这个时代决定谁来统治的是实力，而不是出身。

story: Wu Qi came from the small state of Wey. He served Lu and then Wei, where he guarded the western frontier against Qin. After falling foul of court intrigue in Wei, he went south to Chu. King Dao of Chu made him chief minister.

Chu was large but loosely run, with too many nobles living off state income. Wu Qi ended the hereditary stipends of noble families after three generations, cut useless offices and sent nobles to settle empty frontier land. He used the savings to build a stronger army, and Chu won wars to the south and north.

The nobles hated him. When King Dao died in 381 BCE, they attacked Wu Qi with arrows at the funeral. He threw himself on the king's body, so the arrows also struck the corpse. The new king later executed more than seventy families for this crime.
story_zh: 吴起是卫国人，先后在鲁国和魏国任职，在魏国时镇守西部边境抵御秦国。因卷入魏国朝廷的倾轧，他南下投奔楚国，楚悼王任命他为令尹。
楚国地广人多，但管理松散，靠国家供养的贵族太多。吴起规定贵族封君传三代后收回爵禄，裁撤无用的官职，把贵族迁到空旷的边地开荒，用节省下来的钱粮训练军队。楚国由此南征北战，屡有胜绩。
贵族们对他恨之入骨。前381年楚悼王一死，他们就在丧礼上用箭射杀吴起。吴起扑倒在楚王遗体上，箭也射中了王尸。新即位的楚肃王事后以此罪诛杀了七十多家贵族。
wu-qi-chu.why: Wu Qi's reforms gave Chu a brief burst of strength, but their quick reversal left Chu weaker than Qin in the long run.
wu-qi-chu.why_zh: 吴起变法使楚国一度强盛，但改革很快中断，从长远看楚国终究落后于秦国。

story: Six years after his first reforms, Shang Yang launched a second round in 350 BCE. Qin moved its capital from Yueyang to a new city at Xianyang, on the north bank of the Wei River. Gate towers and palaces were built there, and it stayed the Qin capital until the dynasty fell.

At the same time, small villages were combined into about thirty counties, each run by an official appointed by the ruler, not by a local noble. The old field boundaries were opened up, so land could be bought and sold and taxed by area.
Shang Yang also fixed standard measures for length, volume and weight. A bronze grain measure made under his direction and dated 344 BCE still survives.
story_zh: 首次变法六年后，商鞅于前350年推行第二轮改革。秦国把都城从栎阳迁到渭河北岸新建的咸阳，在那里修建城阙宫殿。此后直到秦朝灭亡，咸阳一直是秦的都城。
与此同时，秦国把小乡小邑合并成三十来个县，每县由国君任命的官吏管理，而不再由地方贵族掌握。旧的田界被打破，土地可以买卖，并按面积征税。
商鞅还统一了长度、容积和重量的标准。一件在他主持下制作、刻有前344年铭文的铜量器“商鞅方升”至今仍然保存着。
xianyang-capital.why: The county system and standard measures became the backbone of the later Qin empire and of Chinese government for two thousand years.
xianyang-capital.why_zh: 县制和统一的度量衡成为后来秦帝国的骨架，也影响了此后两千年的中国政治。

people.name: Shang Yang
people.role: Reformer and chief minister of Qin

story: Shang Yang's reforms had made many enemies. Early on, the heir to the throne broke the law, and Shang Yang punished the prince's tutors in his place, cutting off one tutor's nose. When Duke Xiao died in 338 BCE, that heir became ruler, later known as King Huiwen.

The prince's supporters accused Shang Yang of plotting rebellion. He fled, and according to the Records of the Grand Historian an innkeeper refused him a room because, under Shang Yang's own law, guests without papers could not be lodged. He went back to his fief at Shang and raised troops, but was defeated and killed. His body was torn apart by chariots and his family wiped out.
Yet the new ruler kept almost all of Shang Yang's laws, because they worked.
story_zh: 商鞅变法得罪了很多人。变法初期，太子犯法，商鞅不能处罚储君，便惩办了太子的两位师傅，其中一人被割掉鼻子。前338年秦孝公去世，这位太子即位，就是后来的秦惠文王。
太子一派诬告商鞅谋反。商鞅出逃，据《史记》记载，客店主人不肯收留他，因为按照商鞅自己定的法令，没有凭证的客人不能留宿。他逃回封地商邑起兵，兵败被杀，尸体被车裂示众，全家被诛。
然而新君几乎保留了商鞅的全部法令，因为这些法令确实有效。
shang-yang-death.why: The reformer died, but his system survived, showing that Qin's strength now rested on institutions rather than on one man.
shang-yang-death.why_zh: 变法者死了，制度却延续下来，说明秦国的强大已经建立在制度而非个人之上。

quote.zh: 嗟乎，为法之敝一至此哉！
quote.en: Alas, that the harm of my own laws should come to this!
quote.from: Records of the Grand Historian 史记

story: In 342 BCE Wei attacked Han, and Han asked Qi for help. Once again Qi sent Tian Ji as commander and Sun Bin as strategist, and once again they marched toward the Wei capital. Wei's general Pang Juan turned back to chase them.

Sun Bin had his army light 100,000 cooking fires on the first night, 50,000 on the second and 30,000 on the third. Pang Juan concluded that Qi's soldiers were deserting. He left his infantry behind and raced ahead with light troops.

Sun Bin set an ambush at dusk in a narrow pass at Maling. He stripped the bark from a large tree and wrote: 'Pang Juan dies under this tree.' When Pang Juan arrived and lit a torch to read it, thousands of Qi crossbowmen shot at the light. The Wei army broke, Pang Juan killed himself, and Wei's crown prince was captured.
story_zh: 前342年，魏国进攻韩国，韩国向齐国求救。齐国再次派田忌为将、孙膑为军师，再次直扑魏国都城。魏将庞涓只好回兵追击。
孙膑下令军队第一天挖十万人做饭的灶，第二天减到五万，第三天只剩三万。庞涓断定齐军士兵大量逃亡，便丢下步兵，只带轻装精锐日夜追赶。
孙膑在马陵狭窄的山道设下埋伏，又剥去一棵大树的树皮，在上面写道：“庞涓死于此树之下。”庞涓黄昏赶到，点起火把看字，埋伏的上万齐军弩手朝着火光万箭齐发。魏军大乱，庞涓自刎，魏国太子申被俘。
maling.why: Maling ended Wei's time as the leading power and opened the way for Qi and Qin to dominate.
maling.why_zh: 马陵之战结束了魏国的霸主地位，为齐、秦两国崛起让开了道路。

quote.en: So I have made that boy famous!
quote.from: Records of the Grand Historian 史记

story: Near the Ji Gate of Linzi, the Qi capital, the Tian rulers set up a centre where scholars could live, teach and argue. It grew most famous under King Xuan of Qi, who came to the throne around 319 BCE.

King Xuan gave leading scholars the rank of grand master, fine houses and salaries, without asking them to hold office. They were free to write and debate. Hundreds, perhaps thousands, of thinkers and students gathered there, including Zou Yan with his theory of yin-yang and the five phases, the Daoist-leaning Shen Dao and Tian Pian, and later the Confucian Xunzi, who led the academy three times.
Ideas from many schools met and mixed at Jixia, and works such as parts of the Guanzi may have been written there.
story_zh: 齐国田氏国君在都城临淄的稷门附近设立了一处学宫，供学者居住、讲学和辩论。约前319年即位的齐宣王时期，这里最为兴盛。
齐宣王授予知名学者“上大夫”的待遇，给他们修建宅第、发放俸禄，却不要求他们担任官职，让他们自由著书论辩。聚集在这里的学者和弟子多达数百乃至上千人，其中有提出阴阳五行学说的邹衍，倾向道家的慎到、田骈，后来儒家大师荀子还曾三次担任学宫的“祭酒”。
各家学说在稷下交流融合，《管子》中的部分篇章可能就出自这里。
jixia.why: Jixia was the clearest example of the 'Hundred Schools of Thought' contending, and it shaped Chinese philosophy for centuries.
jixia.why_zh: 稷下学宫是“百家争鸣”最集中的体现，对此后数百年的中国思想影响深远。

story: In 293 BCE Han and Wei joined forces to stop Qin's advance east of the Hangu Pass. Their armies gathered at Yique, the narrow gorge of the Yi River south of Luoyang, where the Longmen caves were later carved.

Qin gave command to Bai Qi, then a young and little-known officer. He saw that the two allies each wanted the other to take the lead in fighting. Using this, he attacked first with a small force to pin down one army, then struck the other with his main force and defeated them one after another.

The Records of the Grand Historian says 240,000 soldiers were beheaded and the Wei general Gongsun Xi was captured. Qin then took five cities. The numbers may be exaggerated, but the defeat crippled Han and Wei for years.
story_zh: 前293年，韩、魏两国联合起来，想阻止秦国在函谷关以东的扩张。两国大军集结在洛阳以南伊河流经的狭窄峡谷伊阙，也就是后来开凿龙门石窟的地方。
秦国任命当时还年轻、名气不大的白起为将。他看出两国都想让对方先打头阵，于是先用少量兵力牵制一方，再集中主力猛攻另一方，将联军逐个击破。
《史记》记载此战斩首二十四万，俘虏魏将公孙喜，秦国随后又攻下五座城。这些数字或许有夸大，但韩、魏多年元气难复。
yique.why: Yique launched Bai Qi's career as Qin's most feared general and opened the road east for Qin.
yique.why_zh: 伊阙之战使白起成为秦国最令人畏惧的名将，也为秦国东进打开了通道。

story: The He Shi Bi was a famous jade disc owned by the King of Zhao. King Zhaoxiang of Qin offered fifteen cities in exchange for it. Zhao feared that if it refused, Qin would attack, and if it agreed, Qin would take the jade and keep the cities. Lin Xiangru, a retainer of a palace official, volunteered to carry the disc.

In the Qin court the king passed the jade around to his ladies and said nothing about the cities. Lin Xiangru told him the jade had a flaw and took it back. Holding it beside a pillar, he threatened to smash both the jade and his own head unless Qin kept its promise. He then secretly sent a servant home with the disc.
The King of Qin, unwilling to kill an envoy for nothing, let Lin Xiangru go. Zhao made him a senior minister.
story_zh: 和氏璧是赵王珍藏的一块名贵玉璧。秦昭襄王提出用十五座城来交换。赵国担心：不给，秦国会来攻打；给了，秦国可能拿了玉不给城。宦者令的门客蔺相如自告奋勇，捧璧出使秦国。
秦王在殿上把玉璧传给姬妾侍从观赏，绝口不提割城的事。蔺相如说玉上有瑕疵，要指给秦王看，借机拿回玉璧，退到柱子旁，声称秦国若不守约，他就把玉璧连同自己的头一起撞碎在柱上。随后他又暗中派随从带着玉璧从小路回到赵国。
秦王觉得杀了使者也于事无补，只好放蔺相如回国。赵王因此提拔他为上大夫。
heshibi.why: The story became the proverb 'returning the jade intact to Zhao' and made Lin Xiangru a model of courage in diplomacy.
heshibi.why_zh: 这个故事留下了成语“完璧归赵”，蔺相如也成为外交场上智勇双全的典范。

quote.zh: 城入赵而璧留秦；城不入，臣请完璧归赵。
quote.en: If the cities go to Zhao, the jade stays in Qin; if they do not, I will bring the jade back to Zhao intact.
quote.from: Records of the Grand Historian 史记

story: Fan Ju was a poor man from Wei. Falsely accused of selling secrets to Qi, he was beaten nearly to death by Wei's chief minister and thrown into a latrine. He escaped and was smuggled to Qin under the false name Zhang Lu.

At that time Qin was run by the Queen Dowager's brother, the Marquis of Rang, who sent armies on long marches against distant Qi. Fan Ju told King Zhaoxiang this was a mistake. Qin should make friends with far-off states and attack its neighbours, Han and Wei, so that every piece of land it won could be held. He also warned the king that his relatives held too much power.
In 266 BCE the king removed the Marquis of Rang and made Fan Ju chancellor. Qin's wars now focused on its near neighbours, leading to the great campaigns against Han and Zhao.
story_zh: 范雎原是魏国的一个穷书生，被诬告向齐国出卖机密，遭魏国相国派人毒打，几乎丧命，还被扔进厕所。他侥幸逃脱，化名张禄被人偷偷带到秦国。
当时秦国大权掌握在太后的弟弟穰侯手里，他屡次派兵远征遥远的齐国。范雎对秦昭襄王说，这样做是错的：秦国应当结交远方的国家，攻打近邻韩、魏，这样夺来的每一寸土地都能守得住。他还提醒秦王，外戚的权力过大了。
前266年，秦王罢免穰侯，任命范雎为相。此后秦国的兵锋集中指向近邻，引出了攻韩伐赵的一系列大战。
fan-ju.why: 'Befriend the distant and attack the near' became Qin's guiding strategy and a classic of Chinese statecraft.
fan-ju.why_zh: “远交近攻”成为秦国兼并六国的指导方针，也是中国古代谋略的经典。

people.name: Marquis of Rang
people.role: Former chancellor, the queen dowager's brother

quote.zh: 王不如远交而近攻，得寸则王之寸也，得尺亦王之尺也。
quote.en: Your Majesty should befriend distant states and attack near ones; every inch you gain is your inch, every foot your foot.
quote.from: Records of the Grand Historian 史记

story: Shangdang was a highland commandery of Han in what is now southeastern Shanxi. In 263 and 262 BCE Qin took Yewang on the Yellow River, cutting Shangdang off from the rest of Han. The Han king agreed to give the commandery to Qin.

But the governor, Feng Ting, and his people did not want to be ruled by Qin. Feng Ting offered Shangdang's seventeen cities to Zhao instead, hoping this would bring Zhao into the war against Qin. At the Zhao court, one adviser warned that accepting land for nothing would bring disaster. Lord Pingyuan argued for taking it, and King Xiaocheng agreed.
Qin was furious at losing a prize it thought it had won. It sent its armies into Shangdang, and Zhao sent Lian Po to meet them at Changping.
story_zh: 上党是韩国的一个高原郡，位于今山西东南部。前263年至前262年，秦国攻取黄河边的野王，把上党与韩国本土切断。韩王只好答应把上党献给秦国。
但上党郡守冯亭和当地百姓不愿归秦。冯亭转而把上党十七座城献给赵国，想借此把赵国拉入抗秦的战争。赵国朝廷上，平阳君认为无故得地必招大祸，平原君却主张接受，赵孝成王听从了平原君。
秦国眼看到手的土地被人夺走，大为恼火，出兵进攻上党；赵国则派廉颇率军在长平迎战。
shangdang.why: Zhao's decision to accept Shangdang led directly to the Battle of Changping, the most destructive battle of the age.
shangdang.why_zh: 赵国接受上党，直接引发了战国时代最惨烈的长平之战。

story: After Changping, Qin moved on to Zhao's capital, Handan, and laid siege to it from 259 BCE. Bai Qi argued the moment had passed and refused to lead the campaign, so others took command. The city held out for more than two years while food ran short.

Zhao's Lord Pingyuan went to Chu to ask for help. When talks stalled, his retainer Mao Sui, who had volunteered himself for the mission, walked up to the King of Chu with his hand on his sword and won an alliance. Wei sent an army but ordered it to wait at the border, fearing Qin.

Lord Xinling, the Wei king's half-brother, got a royal concubine to steal the army's tiger tally. He took command, killed the general who refused to obey, and marched with Chu's forces to Handan. In 257 BCE the allies broke the siege. Bai Qi, blamed for his refusal, was ordered to kill himself.
story_zh: 长平之战后，秦军乘势进军赵都邯郸，从前259年起围城。白起认为战机已失，拒绝领兵，秦王只好改派他人。邯郸坚守两年多，城中粮食几近断绝。
赵国平原君前往楚国求援，谈判迟迟没有结果。主动请缨随行的门客毛遂按剑走到楚王面前，慷慨陈词，促成了楚赵联盟，这就是“毛遂自荐”的由来。魏国也派了援军，却因害怕秦国，命令军队停在边境观望。
魏王的异母弟信陵君请魏王宠妃如姬盗出兵符，夺取兵权，击杀不肯交出军队的大将晋鄙，与楚军一同驰援邯郸。前257年，联军解了邯郸之围。白起因拒绝出战获罪，被逼自杀。
handan-siege.why: Handan was Qin's biggest setback of the century and showed that the other states could still stop it when they united.
handan-siege.why_zh: 邯郸之战是秦国这一百年里最大的挫败，说明各国一旦联合，仍能遏制秦国。

story: By the 3rd century BCE the Zhou king ruled only a tiny area around Luoyang, and even that was split between two small courts called Western Zhou and Eastern Zhou. King Nan of Zhou, who had reigned for nearly sixty years, was poor and powerless.

In 256 BCE, after the Qin defeat at Handan, King Nan joined a plan by other states to attack Qin. Qin struck first. The king went to Qin, bowed in apology and handed over his remaining 36 towns and their people. He died the same year. Tradition says Qin carried off the Nine Cauldrons, the ancient symbol of royal authority.
In 249 BCE Qin also ended the small Eastern Zhou court. The Zhou dynasty, founded around 1046 BCE, was gone.
story_zh: 到公元前三世纪，周天子只统治洛阳周围一小块地方，而且还分裂成“西周”“东周”两个小朝廷。在位近六十年的周赧王既穷又无实权。
前256年，秦军在邯郸受挫后，周赧王参与了各国合谋攻秦的计划。秦国抢先出兵，周赧王只好到秦国叩头谢罪，献出剩下的三十六座城邑和百姓，当年便去世了。相传秦国把象征王权的九鼎也搬走了。
前249年，秦国又灭掉了东周小朝廷。约前1046年建立的周朝至此彻底终结。
zhou-ends.why: The end of the Zhou removed the last symbol of a shared royal order and left the field open for a new kind of ruler.
zhou-ends.why_zh: 周朝灭亡，各国共尊的王室象征从此不复存在，为一种全新的统治者让出了位置。

story: The Min River rushes out of the mountains onto the Chengdu Plain. In the past it flooded the plain in summer and left the eastern side dry. Around 256 BCE, Li Bing, the Qin governor of Shu, set out to tame it.

Instead of a dam, Li Bing built a long artificial island, the Fish Mouth, that divides the river into an inner and an outer stream. The outer stream carries floods and stones away; the inner stream flows through a channel cut through solid rock, the Bottle-Neck, into a network of irrigation canals. A low spillway, the Flying Sand Weir, sends extra water and silt back to the outer river. Workers cracked the rock by heating it with fire and then pouring cold water on it.
The system is still in use and was named a World Heritage site in 2000.
story_zh: 岷江从群山中奔流而出，冲向成都平原。过去夏季常常泛滥成灾，平原东部却又干旱缺水。约前256年，秦国蜀郡守李冰着手治理岷江。
李冰没有修筑拦河大坝，而是筑起一道形似鱼嘴的分水堤，把江水分为内江和外江。外江排洪排沙；内江经过在岩山上凿开的“宝瓶口”流入纵横交错的灌溉渠网。低矮的“飞沙堰”则把多余的江水和泥沙排回外江。当时开山凿石，靠的是先用火烧、再泼冷水让岩石崩裂。
这项工程至今仍在发挥作用，2000年被列入世界文化遗产。
dujiangyan.why: Dujiangyan made Sichuan 'the land of abundance' and fed Qin's armies during the wars of unification.
dujiangyan.why_zh: 都江堰使四川成为“天府之国”，也为秦国统一战争提供了充足的粮草。

story: Ying Zheng was born in 259 BCE in Handan, where his father Zichu was living as a Qin hostage. A rich merchant, Lü Buwei, spent a fortune helping Zichu become heir to the Qin throne. Zichu reigned as King Zhuangxiang for only three years.

When he died, Zheng became king at the age of thirteen. Lü Buwei, now chancellor, ran the government, and the young king called him 'second father'. Lü kept up Qin's wars, gathered thousands of retainers and sponsored large projects. Work on the king's tomb at Mount Li also began in this reign.
Zheng would take personal control in 238 BCE. Over the following seventeen years he conquered the other six states and made himself the First Emperor.
story_zh: 嬴政于前259年生在邯郸，当时他的父亲子楚正在赵国做人质。富商吕不韦倾尽家财，帮子楚当上了秦国的王位继承人。子楚即位为秦庄襄王，只在位三年。
庄襄王死后，十三岁的嬴政继承王位。担任相国的吕不韦执掌朝政，被年幼的秦王尊称为“仲父”。吕不韦继续对外用兵，门下养着数千食客，还主持了许多大型工程。秦王在骊山的陵墓也是从这时开始修建的。
前238年嬴政亲政，此后十七年间先后灭掉六国，自称始皇帝。
ying-zheng-king.why: The accession of the boy king began the reign that would end the Warring States.
ying-zheng-king.why_zh: 少年秦王即位，开启了终结战国时代的统治。

people.name: Ying Zheng
people.role: King of Qin, later the First Emperor

story: Han, Qin's weak neighbour, came up with a plan to keep Qin too busy to attack. It sent a skilled water engineer named Zheng Guo to persuade Qin to dig a great canal across the Guanzhong plain. The huge project, Han hoped, would drain Qin's labour and money.

Work began in 246 BCE. Partway through, the plot was discovered, and Qin wanted to kill Zheng Guo. He replied that the scheme might buy Han a few years, but the canal would benefit Qin for generations. Qin let him finish it.

The canal ran about 150 kilometres from the Jing River east to the Luo River. Its silty water fertilized and washed tens of thousands of hectares of salty land. Guanzhong became rich farmland, and Qin grew stronger, not weaker.
story_zh: 秦国的弱邻韩国想出一个计策，让秦国忙得无暇东进。它派出水利专家郑国，劝说秦国在关中平原上开凿一条大渠，希望借这项浩大的工程消耗秦国的人力财力。
工程于前246年动工。修到一半，计谋败露，秦国要杀郑国。郑国说：这个计策也许能让韩国多苟延几年，但渠修成后却是秦国万世之利。秦国于是让他把渠修完。
郑国渠从泾水向东引水到洛水，全长约一百五十公里。含泥沙的渠水既能肥田又能冲洗盐碱，使大片盐碱地变成良田。关中从此成为沃野，秦国不但没被拖垮，反而更加强大。
zhengguo-canal.why: Together with Dujiangyan, the canal gave Qin the food to support the armies that unified China.
zhengguo-canal.why_zh: 郑国渠与都江堰一起，为秦国统一中国的大军提供了粮食保障。

story: Like the great lords of other states, Qin's chancellor Lü Buwei kept a large household of retainers, said to number three thousand. He set many of them to work writing down everything they knew about the world and how to govern it.

The result, completed around 239 BCE, was the Lüshi Chunqiu (Master Lü's Spring and Autumn Annals), a book of 26 parts and 160 chapters. It draws on Confucian, Daoist, Mohist, Legalist and yin-yang ideas, and it is arranged partly by the months and seasons of the year.

To show off the work, Lü had it displayed at the gate of the Xianyang market. He offered a thousand pieces of gold to anyone who could add or remove a single word. The saying 'one word worth a thousand gold' comes from this story.
story_zh: 与其他国家的权贵一样，秦相吕不韦门下也养着大批食客，据说有三千人。他让这些人把各自对天地万物和治国之道的见解记录下来。
约前239年，这部书编成，名为《吕氏春秋》，共二十六卷、一百六十篇。它兼采儒、道、墨、法、阴阳各家思想，部分内容按一年十二个月的时令编排。
为了炫耀此书，吕不韦把它公布在咸阳市场的城门上，宣称谁能增删一个字就赏千金。成语“一字千金”就出自这里。
lushi-chunqiu.why: The book preserves many early ideas that would otherwise be lost and shows how the schools of thought were starting to blend.
lushi-chunqiu.why_zh: 这部书保存了许多本会失传的早期思想，也反映出各家学说正在走向融合。

quote.zh: 有能增损一字者予千金。
quote.en: Whoever can add or remove a single word will be given a thousand gold.
quote.from: Records of the Grand Historian 史记

story: Lao Ai was a favourite of the Queen Dowager, Ying Zheng's mother. Disguised as a eunuch, he lived in her palace, had two sons with her and was made a marquis with great wealth and many retainers.

In 238 BCE the king, now 22, went to the old capital Yong for his coming-of-age ceremony. Lao Ai used forged seals to raise troops and attack the palace. The king's forces defeated him at Xianyang. Lao Ai was torn apart by chariots, his family wiped out, and his two sons by the Queen Dowager were killed. She was sent away from the capital for a time.
Lü Buwei, who had first introduced Lao Ai to the palace, was dismissed the next year and later exiled to Shu. He poisoned himself in 235 BCE. From then on Ying Zheng ruled alone.
story_zh: 嫪毐是秦王嬴政之母赵太后的宠臣。他假扮宦官住进太后宫中，与太后生了两个儿子，还被封为长信侯，家财万贯，门客众多。
前238年，二十二岁的秦王到旧都雍城举行冠礼。嫪毐伪造玉玺调兵，企图攻打王宫，在咸阳被秦王的军队击败。嫪毐被车裂，夷灭三族，他与太后所生的两个儿子也被处死，太后一度被迁出都城。
当初把嫪毐引进宫中的吕不韦第二年被罢免，后来又被贬往蜀地，前235年饮毒酒自尽。从此嬴政独揽大权。
lao-ai.why: Crushing Lao Ai and removing Lü Buwei put real power in Ying Zheng's hands, just before the final wars of conquest.
lao-ai.why_zh: 平定嫪毐、罢免吕不韦，使嬴政真正掌握大权，随即展开了统一六国的最后战争。

story: Han Fei was a prince of the state of Han. He and Li Si both studied under the Confucian Xunzi, but Han Fei turned toward Legalism. He stammered badly and expressed his ideas in writing. He argued that a ruler should govern by clear laws, by skilful control of his officials and by the power of his position.

When King Zheng of Qin read his essays, such as 'Solitary Indignation' and 'The Five Vermin', he said he would die happy if he could meet the author. In 233 BCE, with Qin attacking Han, Han sent Han Fei to Qin as an envoy.

Li Si, now a Qin minister, feared his old classmate's talent and warned that Han Fei would always be loyal to Han. Han Fei was thrown into prison, and Li Si sent him poison. The king changed his mind too late.
story_zh: 韩非是韩国的公子，与李斯同为儒家大师荀子的学生，却转向了法家。他口吃严重，便专心著书立说，主张君主应当依靠明确的法令、驾驭臣下的权术和君位本身的权势来治国，即“法、术、势”结合。
秦王嬴政读到他的《孤愤》《五蠹》等文章，感叹说：要是能见到作者并与他交往，死也无憾了。前233年，秦国攻打韩国，韩国派韩非出使秦国。
已在秦国做官的李斯忌惮这位同窗的才华，向秦王进言说韩非终究会忠于韩国。韩非被投入狱中，李斯派人送去毒药。等秦王后悔想赦免他时，已经来不及了。
han-fei.why: Han Fei's book, the Han Feizi, is the fullest statement of Legalist thought and guided the Qin empire's harsh system.
han-fei.why_zh: 《韩非子》是法家思想的集大成之作，也是秦帝国严刑峻法的理论依据。

quote.zh: 嗟乎，寡人得见此人与之游，死不恨矣！
quote.en: Ah, if I could meet this man and spend time with him, I would die without regret!
quote.from: Records of the Grand Historian 史记
